zh.caption: 圖 5｜文件檢核的四種狀態
zh.description: 四張卡是不同情境，並非每次操作必然經過的四個步驟。缺漏時補填；系統故障另提示安全重試；完成只代表本次資料檢核。

items.title: 狀態一：輸入
items.body:
等待使用者填寫資料

案件編號：A001

來源單位：甲部門

文件類型：尚未選擇

［檢查資料］

下一步：填寫並啟動檢查。

items.title: 狀態二：處理中
items.body:
已收到檢查請求

正在檢查資料…

請勿重複送出。

完成後將顯示檢查結果。

［檢查中，暫不可再送出］

下一步：等待結果；逾時則依提示處理。

items.title: 狀態三：缺漏
items.body:
已找到可修正的問題

缺少必要資料

「文件類型」尚未填寫。

已保留其他欄位。

［補填並重新檢查］

下一步：只修正缺漏，不必全部重填。

items.title: 狀態四：完成
items.body:
本次資料檢核已完成

三個必要欄位均已齊全

可以預覽或匯出。

注意：不代表正式受理。

［預覽］［匯出］

下一步：確認內容，再選擇匯出。

zh.caption: 圖 6｜資料改變後，兩種結果處理方式
zh.description: 箭頭表示同一案例的資料變更。下方是互斥的錯誤／正確策略對照，不是兩個連續步驟。

items.title: 原始資料通過
items.body: 資料 A → 檢核通過 → 產生結果 A

items.title: 使用者修改資料
items.body: 資料 B；先前結果仍對應資料 A

items.title: 錯誤做法
items.body: 仍顯示結果 A 已通過，讓人誤以為資料 B 也通過。

items.title: 正確做法
items.body: 提示資料已變更，舊檢核失效，需要重新檢查。

en.description: Static structure: only the second of three panels is expanded. Symbols indicate states, not sequence. A working control needs keyboard access and an exposed expanded state.

en.caption: Figure 5 | Four states of document checking
en.description: The cards compare situations, not four mandatory sequential steps. Correct missing data; handle system failure with safe-retry guidance. Completion means this data check only.

items.title: State 1: Input
items.body:
Waiting for user input

Case ID: A001

Source unit: Department A

Document type: Not selected

[Check data]

Next: complete the fields and start checking.

items.title: State 2: Processing
items.body:
Check request received

Checking data…

Do not submit again.

The result will appear when checking finishes.

[Checking; resubmission unavailable]

Next: wait for the result; follow guidance if it times out.

items.title: State 3: Missing data
items.body:
A correctable problem was found

Required data is missing

Document type has not been entered.

Other fields have been retained.

[Complete and recheck]

Next: correct the omission without re-entering everything.

items.title: State 4: Complete
items.body:
This data check is complete

All three required fields are complete

Preview or export is available.

Note: this does not mean formal acceptance.

[Preview] [Export]

Next: confirm the content, then choose export.

en.caption: Figure 6 | Two ways to handle results after a data change
en.description: Arrows indicate a data change in one example. The lower cards compare alternative incorrect/correct strategies, not consecutive steps.

items.title: Original data passes
items.body: Data A → check passes → result A

items.title: User changes data
items.body: Data B; the previous result still refers to data A

items.title: Incorrect approach
items.body: Continue showing result A as passed, misleading users into thinking data B passed too.

items.title: Correct approach
items.body: Say that data has changed, the old check is invalid and rechecking is required.
